description.short: Classic rich muscatel flavor ('muscatel'), the most recognized and sought-after harvest of Darjeeling
description.overview: The second flush is considered the signature flavor profile of Darjeeling worldwide — praised for its distinctive muscatel note reminiscent of sweet muscat grapes, which earned the region global fame.
description.leaf: Twisted, brownish-purple leaf with visible silvery tips
description.taste: Rich, fruity, with signature 'muscatel' sweetness and medium-full body
description.processing: Plucking → withering → rolling → deeper oxidation than first flush → drying

history.origin: The distinctive muscatel character of the second flush is linked to small green tea jassids (leafhoppers), whose bites trigger stress defenses in the leaves that synthesize unique aromatic compounds.
history.development: This insect-induced reaction is similar to Taiwan's famed Oriental Beauty — a rare occurrence where an agricultural pest contributes to the signature excellence of a tea.
history.modern: Darjeeling Second Flush is the most internationally celebrated export from the region, anchoring Darjeeling's reputation as the Champagne of Teas.
interestingFacts: The descriptor 'muscatel' has become the universal industry benchmark for top-tier Darjeeling second flush.
The link between leafhopper feeding and muscatel flavor makes the vintage dependent on annual weather conditions, as insect activity varies year to year.
